segments.title: 第143章 梅開二度
segments.content:
Rekindling the Verdant Years Chapter 143: A Second Blooming

Ying Chanxi was still a bit dazed.

When she fell, her mind had gone completely blank.

The moment she actually hit the ground, the pain that shot through her body made it difficult for her to think.

The moment she looked up at her surroundings, she subconsciously searched for Li Luo's figure.

When she saw Li Luo rushing over, her heart finally calmed down a little.

So, her mind naturally began to fantasize that if Li Luo came over, would he carry her to the infirmary or something...

But...

The way things unfolded seemed completely different from what she had imagined.

It was the first time she had heard Yan Zhusheng's voice so cold, shouting at the people around them not to block the way before sweeping her up in an instant.

Held so lightly in Yan Zhusheng's arms, Ying Chanxi was dumbfounded. Her gaze passed through the strands of hair by Yan Zhusheng's ear to Li Luo, who was following behind, and for a moment, she didn't know what to say.

She wanted Li Luo to carry her, but in this situation, how could she bring herself to say it?

In the end, she could only bury her face in Yan Zhusheng's arms and pretend she knew nothing.

The school infirmary was located at the side entrance next to the gymnasium's main gate, not far from the 100-meter finish line.

After Yan Zhusheng carried Ying Chanxi to the infirmary in one go, she placed her on a sickbed as instructed by the infirmary doctor.

At that moment, a crowd of people suddenly surged in from outside.

The teacher in the infirmary glanced over, looked at the faces of Ying Chanxi and Yan Zhusheng, and then said impatiently, "Those who aren't injured, please don't come in. At most, two people can stay to accompany her. Everyone else, wait outside. Don't crowd the infirmary."

At that, people like Qiao Xinyan and Xu Yinghuan obediently headed out.

Meanwhile, Xie Shuchen and Liu Shaowen exchanged a look and started jostling each other at the doorway. Their shoving only ceased in silence when they saw Li Luo rush into the infirmary, after which they both huffed at each other.

"How did you get hurt?" The infirmary teacher glanced at Ying Chanxi, looked at her scraped elbow, and then asked.

"I fell while sprinting at the finish line during the 100-meter race," Li Luo said from the side.

"Is your leg injured too?"

"My knee hurts a little," Ying Chanxi said softly, pursing her lips.

"Roll up your pant leg, let me see the knee." The infirmary teacher instructed, "Which knee?"

"The right one."

Yan Zhusheng was standing on the right side, so she stepped forward to help Ying Chanxi slowly roll up her pant leg.

Meanwhile, the infirmary teacher first examined Ying Chanxi's arm, holding her hand and checking it with a few movements.

"Does this hurt?"

"How about this?"

"Hiss..."

"Oh, you've injured your wrist too. The elbow is probably just a scrape. Did you use your wrist to break your fall when you fell?"

By now, Yan Zhusheng had rolled up Ying Chanxi's pant leg. The infirmary teacher let go of Ying Chanxi's arm and turned to examine her right leg.

Then, she concluded, "The elbow isn't a big problem, just a simple scrape with a little bleeding. I'll just disinfect it for you."

"As for the left wrist, you probably injured it when you broke your fall. It'll need some time to rest."

"Then there's the knee. It's also scraped, and you might have slightly injured the tendons, but the bone should be fine."

As she spoke, the infirmary teacher had already begun to disinfect her wounds.

Li Luo watched from the side, his hand tightly gripped by Ying Chanxi's right hand. She was squeezing with all her might.

After a short while, the infirmary teacher finished treating her and gave her some instructions.

Just then, Teacher Sun, the head teacher of Class One, also rushed over and asked about her condition with concern.

By this time, Ying Chanxi was feeling much better. At the very least, she could manage to get out of bed and walk. As long as she didn't touch her wounds, she could walk with a limp.

"Teacher Sun."

"Hm?"

"Please don't tell my dad about this," Ying Chanxi said. "It's not a big deal, and I don't want him to worry too much."

Teacher Sun frowned, then asked the infirmary teacher for more details about her condition. After confirming it was nothing serious and that she just needed to rest, he nodded. "But if your condition worsens, you must tell me immediately."

"Li Luo, you help me keep an eye on her." Saying this, Teacher Sun looked at Li Luo beside him. "You two live together, so you'll have to take extra care of her."

Li Luo nodded.

The infirmary teacher at the side glanced at Li Luo with great interest, feeling as if she had just overheard some juicy student gossip.

After they left the infirmary, Teacher Sun gave a few more instructions and reminders, said something to Jian Zhenyuan, the vice class president of Class One, and then left.

At this point, many students from Class One who had seen Ying Chanxi fall had gathered outside the infirmary.

When they saw Ying Chanxi walk out, they all rushed to ask after her.

Despite how Ying Chanxi acted in front of Li Luo, she held quite a bit of prestige in her own class.

She was always very proper in her words and actions, and as the top student who had long dominated the grade rankings, everyone both adored and revered her.

"Chanxi, this is for you." Qiao Xinyan handed over a bronze medal and said with a smile, "Third place."

This bronze medal could be considered a blessing in disguise.

Originally, apart from Yan Zhusheng and Luo Jiajia, who had pulled ahead of the others by a certain margin, the rest of the runners from third to sixth place were all running at about the same speed.

Ying Chanxi was originally in about fifth place, but when she stumbled right before the finish line, she pitched forward, which, by a twist of fate, earned her third place.

"Zhusheng, this one is yours." Xu Yinghuan grinned and produced a gold medal. "I collected it for you, but you two will still have to go to the podium to retake the photo. I don't know if Chanxi can do it right now."

"I just took a fall, it's not like my leg is broken," Ying Chanxi said with a smile. She rested a hand on Li Luo's shoulder and limped toward the sports field. "Everyone, you don't need to crowd around. Go back to the stands and watch the events."

After confirming that Ying Chanxi wasn't seriously hurt, most of the people dispersed.

Only a few, like Liu Shaowen, and some boys from Class Two, Three, and Four who admired Ying Chanxi, remained, unwilling to leave.

So they followed behind, watching as Li Luo escorted Ying Chanxi to the podium on the sports field.

The second-place winner, Luo Jiajia, had been waiting there for a long time.

Yan Zhusheng stood on the first-place platform, and with Li Luo's help, Ying Chanxi stepped onto the third-place step.

Under the lens of the photography club members, the top three finishers of the Grade 10 girls' 100-meter final were recorded.

"Is Chanxi alright?"

At that moment, Xu Youyu, who had heard about Ying Chanxi's injury, also rushed over from the presidium and asked with concern.

"She's fine, just her left wrist and right knee need to rest for a while," Li Luo said. "We might have to trouble you, senior, to take care of her a bit more recently."

"Isn't that what I should do?" Xu Youyu smiled and winked at Ying Chanxi. "I can help Chanxi take a bath, you know."

Ying Chanxi's face turned beet red at her words, and she quickly waved her hands. "Senior, please don't say things like that out here."

"Haha, what does it matter?"

Being reminded by Xu Youyu, Ying Chanxi suddenly had a thought.

If Xu Youyu wasn't living with them, it would just be her and Li Luo at home.

With her hand and leg both injured, not only would she need Li Luo's help getting dressed and undressed, but bathing might also...

Eek! Ying Chanxi didn't dare to think any further.

But the more likely scenario would be that her dad would be notified, and in the end, she would have to ask Lin Xiuhong to come over and help.

After the photos for the 100-meter final were taken, Qiao Xinyan helped Ying Chanxi back to the Class One stands to sit obediently. She wasn't allowed to run around, except to go to the bathroom.

Meanwhile, Li Luo slowly ambled over to the presidium, wrote two announcements for his class on the spot, and returned the microphone to the announcer after reading them.

Yan Zhusheng had followed him all the way. While he was reading the announcements, she quietly pulled Xu Youyu aside to say something. After getting a nod from Xu Youyu, she returned to Li Luo's side, satisfied.

Xu Yinghuan, who was trailing beside them, watched with a stunned expression as Li Luo casually made up two announcements, looking as if he hadn't prepared at all.

"No wonder our class didn't collect any announcements yesterday afternoon," Xu Yinghuan couldn't help but say. "Turns out you covered it all, Class President."

"What else?" Li Luo raised an eyebrow. "You think the Student Union is that easy to fool?"

"I just figured you were a favorite of Senior Xu," Xu Yinghuan scratched her head. "I thought you pulled some strings."

"You could say I pulled some strings, I guess," Xu Youyu chimed in from the side. "I've never seen someone just make them up on the spot like that."

Li Luo chuckled twice, then led Yan Zhusheng and Xu Yinghuan back to the Class Eight stands.

When the class saw Yan Zhusheng finally return, a round of cheers and applause erupted.

After all, it was a gold medal in the 100-meter dash, which carried quite a bit of weight.

When it was ten-thirty in the morning, Yan Zhusheng set out again and won the gold medal for the 200-meter race. Including her eighth-place finish in the high jump, Yan Zhusheng had earned a total of 21 class points for Class Eight in individual events alone.

In terms of overall contribution, she was indisputably number one in Class Eight.

By the afternoon, a series of events had come to an end one after another.

The final event on Friday, the men's 3000-meter race, was about to begin its preparations.

Zhu Yufei called out towards the stands, "Class President, and Wei Chun, it's almost time for the 3000-meter race."

"Got it."

Li Luo nodded, got up to go check in at the gymnasium, and glanced at the seat beside him, only to find that Yan Zhusheng hadn't returned since she left earlier.

"Where's Yan Zhusheng?" Li Luo asked.

Xu Yinghuan shook her head blankly. "Didn't she go to the bathroom?"

"It's been more than ten minutes," Li Luo said as he was already walking down from the stands. "Forget it, I'll go check in first."

As he made his way to the gymnasium with Wei Chun, for a rare moment, Li Luo wasn't accompanied by a certain girl.

But when he reached the PE teacher, he saw Xu Youyu again.

"Senior, what are you doing here?"

"I'm in charge of guiding the 3000-meter race," Xu Youyu rolled her eyes at him. "This was supposed to be Chanxi's responsibility, but since her leg is injured, I came to take her place."

"No wonder," Li Luo nodded in understanding.

"Oh, right," Xu Youyu seemed to remember something and pointed towards the presidium with a grin. "Don't rush to line up yet. Go take a look at the entrance. There's a surprise."

"A surprise? What surprise?"

Li Luo was completely bewildered by her words, but he still walked to the gymnasium entrance, though he didn't know what he was supposed to be looking at.

But in the next second, the sports meet's background music stopped.

A familiar guitar sound began to play.

At the same time, an even more familiar voice rang out.

"It turns out by spinning on my own"

"I can find the light"

"The sun has always been in that place"

Yan Zhusheng's figure appeared on the presidium, holding the guitar Li Luo had used, singing the song Li Luo had sung.

She instantly captured everyone's attention.

(End of this chapter)
